## Products
- Living room furniture: sofas, coffee tables, TV units, lounge chairs
- Bedroom furniture: beds, wardrobes, dressing tables, nightstands
- Dining furniture: dining tables, chairs, sideboards
- Office furniture: desks, office chairs, bookshelves
- Kitchen furniture: cabinets, kitchen islands
- Home decor: rugs, lamps, wall decor
